reasons.detail: target_2_0_action is RESEARCH, but INGEST_PACKET_SCHEMA.json admits only KEEP, REPAIR, ADAPT_TO_GRID, REPLACE_WITH_VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR, COMPATIBILITY_ONLY, RETIRE_WITH_EVIDENCE, or UNDECIDED. One invalid required atom makes the packet nonconforming as a canonical ingest packet.

The packet binds its spawn-after-approval specification claim to architekt_governance.md lines 1-7. Direct source inspection of that span shows the Phase-17 cadence preamble, not the later spawn paragraph. The semantic claim may exist later in the same file, but the line-bound atom is not admissible as written.

source_grounded_atoms.claim: handoff() creates an entityos_arbeitspaket and deterministic handoff capsule; its own docstring explicitly states that stern itself delegates/spawns nothing and only records delegation material for a coordinator.
The pinned repository hook configuration contains the observed session/tool/stop lifecycle hooks but no SubagentStart/SubagentStop entries in the inspected file.

The packet's exact provenance span is wrong. The inspected beginning of the file is cadence text. A later paragraph does state that the architect agent is spawned only after approval, so the semantic claim must be reissued with the exact later source span rather than accepted under the wrong line identity.

external_or_unobserved_atoms.reason: The packet cites current Claude Code documentation, but this trigger did not establish the installed target build or emitted payload identity. No local/native runtime credit is granted.
A deterministic parent tool invocation to native child identity join remains unobserved; packet action RESEARCH is itself outside the canonical schema enum.

work_execution_binding_v1.authority_law: WorkExecutionBinding does not create a second spawn authority, truth authority, memory authority, or effect authority.
work_execution_binding_v1.handoff_law: Successful handoff persistence is not successful native spawn/execution/completion evidence.
work_execution_binding_v1.completion_law: Only observed child completion/results may re-enter completion/effect/world-model learning paths; planned work and generated narration remain noncanonical candidates.

Require an executable acceptance fixture proving one paket_id -> one observed native invocation -> one observed child identity/task identity where available -> one completion/result, plus rejection of ambiguous, duplicated, stale-generation, or missing joins.
